root_cause.text: A race condition exists in the mt7915 driver where the dump_work work item may still be running or pending after the crash_data is freed in mt7915_coredump_unregister(), because no synchronization (cancel_work_sync) is performed before deallocation.
root_cause.evidence: The CVE description and patch commit message detail the race: CPU 0 (removal path) calls mt7915_coredump_unregister() and vfrees crash_data, while CPU 1 (workqueue) concurrently executes mt7915_mac_dump_work() which dereferences the freed crash_data. The fix adds cancel_work_sync(&dev->dump_work) in mt7915_unregister_device() before mt7915_coredump_unregister() to ensure the work is cancelled before the data is freed.
